title: The Last of the Huggermuggers
author: Christopher Pearse Cranch
description: "The Last of the Huggermuggers" by Christopher Pearse Cranch is a children's fantasy novel likely written in the mid-19th century, during a time when imaginative literature for young readers was gaining popularity.
longDescription: The story follows the adventures of a young sailor named Jacky Cable, affectionately called Little Jacket, who finds himself shipwrecked on an island inhabited by giants.

authorInfo.bio: Christopher Pearse Cranch (1813–1892) wrote The Last of the Huggermuggers. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
